findings.problem: The hint 'the side, not left' points to the side itself, so a learner could fairly answer the noun 'la derecha' (as in 'a la derecha') rather than the adjective 'derecho'.
findings.fix: hint: describing a noun, the side, not left, as in my right arm

back.es: right (on the right-hand side, as opposed to left); also straight

note: The new hint also keeps this card apart from the word's other cards: el derecho (something you are entitled to) and derecho (straight ahead).
